headline: Guinea-Bissau Cancels US-Funded $1.6 Million Newborn Vaccine Trial
summary: The government of Guinea-Bissau refused authorization for a $1.6 million US-funded hepatitis B vaccine trial involving 14,000 newborns. The trial was canceled following international criticism of its trial design.
why: Regulatory authorization for clinical trials dictates pharmaceutical investment and healthcare governance standards in developing markets.

impacts.name: Guinea-Bissau
impacts.why: Trial cancellation halts $1.6 million in foreign clinical research funding.
